page_title: Screenpipe | AI memory and workflow discovery

summary.name: Screenpipe
summary.one_liner: Screenpipe is a tool that records your screen, audio, and app activity locally so AI agents can search that work history and help with summaries, workflow discovery, and automation.
use_cases: Search past screen content or meeting audio
Map recurring workflows and find steps to automate
Draft summaries and follow-ups from meetings
Give AI agents context about daily work
Review invoice or approval processes for improvements
Keep a portable local copy of work history
summary.what_it_does: Screenpipe captures screen content (accessibility data, screen frames with OCR fallback) and audio transcripts from your device and stores them locally. You can scrub back through your day to find a specific screen, document, or conversation. An agent can query this history through a local REST API or MCP server to understand your work, draft summaries and follow-ups, and identify repeated steps across apps. The page shows an example that maps an invoice process and flags a possible automation, with payment approval kept with the user. It also offers controls to exclude apps, windows, and URLs, redact sensitive fields on device, and an enterprise workspace for device management, policies, and audit trails.
notable: Local-first storage with a local database, REST API, and MCP server so history is portable across models
Combines accessibility data, OCR fallback on screen frames, and audio transcripts
Exclude apps, windows, and URLs and redact sensitive fields on device
Enterprise workspace for devices, identity, policies, storage, and audit trails
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Enterprise deployment features are described but their availability and terms are not detailed
